fields.description: Weekly issue featuring holiday-themed editorials and satire about Christmas in Miami, tourism and seasonal business conditions, and local amusements. Includes commentary on Miami Beach development and recreation (including golf courses and a new dog track), society and nightlife notes, letters to the editor (including concerns about milk quality and cost), and extensive advertisements for restaurants, hotels, theaters, clubs, and holiday events in Miami and Miami Beach.
